messages.subject: control group option
parts:
Dear Group,

I tried the "control group" option to include higher order IGMRF prior, But in a toy simulated example (attached), the optimizer diverged to positive infinity for the precision parameters of the IGMRF.

The attached "sim_data" were simulated from 24 time periods and an 8x8 regular lattice, Data were generated from the following model

y_it = \mu_it+ x_it + \epsilon_it where i denotes pixel and t denote time period.

The IGMRF prior on x has $Q1 \otimes Q2$ as its precision matrix, where Q2 is the precision matrix for ICAR on 8x8 lattice and Q1 is the precision matrix for RW1.

Regards

Dong Liang

messages.subject: Re: control group option
parts:
my indexing for the data was time within pixel, this is in-consistent with the control.group setting where data must be ordered first by group. Thanks for helping me figuring that out.

please see the fixed code:

library(INLA)
library(spdep)
load('sim_data.rda')
nb2INLA(nb,file='sim.graph')
str(sim_data)

## change the data order by time (group)
oo <- with(sim_data,order(j,i))
sim_data <- sim_data[oo,]
 
formula <- y ~ f(i,model="besag",graph="sim.graph",group=j,
            control.group=list(model="rw1"),constr=F)-1
result = inla(formula,data=sim_data,family="gaussian",verbose=T)

cor(sim_data$y,result$summary.random$i$mean)
